suite: World View V1 Field Package Binary Envelope Validation Vectors
contract: ME-05-08 Field Package Binary Envelope & Directory Specification V0.1

cases.scenario: Parse a valid 72-byte header with format 1.0 and exact package length.
Reject a short header or wrong 8-byte magic.
Reject a header length other than 72 or nonzero reserved/header flags.
Reject package_length that differs from actual file length.
Reject section offsets or lengths that overflow checked arithmetic.
Reject manifest offset other than 72 or section order that overlaps.
Reject a directory length inconsistent with 16 + entry_count × 72.
Reject directory version/entry size/flags unsupported by the reader.
Reject duplicate or non-canonically ordered tile coordinates.
Reject a tile entry whose valid dimensions exceed tile dimensions.
Reject missing tile entries for cells intersecting the declared grid.
Reject payload offsets not aligned to 8 bytes.
Reject overlapping, out-of-range or truncated payload ranges.
Reject decoded_length inconsistent with manifest sample and mask layout.
Read codec 0 payload where stored_length equals decoded_length.
Reject codec 0 when stored_length differs from decoded_length.
Reject codec_id not present in the manifest codec registry.
Reject tile hash mismatch after decode.
Reject complete package Asset hash mismatch.
Read one requested tile without decoding unrelated tile payloads.
Verify zero-filled alignment padding and canonical section placement.
Reject nonzero reserved bytes or unknown required flags.
Verify package owner IDs in diagnostic manifest fields match Core Domain owner metadata when present.
Reject manifest that attempts to override Core Domain Field Dataset/Revision identity.
Produce byte-identical package output from equal canonical input on Windows and macOS.
Reject unsupported major version and unsupported required minor extension.
Verify one-level V1 directory has no resolution-level ambiguity.
Reject a package that appends trailing bytes beyond package_length.
